definitions.explanation: The specific value assigned to an attribute or property of an object, element, or data record. Common in computing, databases, XML/HTML, and gaming contexts.

examples.japanese: {属性値|ぞくせいち}を{変更|へんこう}する。
HTMLタグの{属性値|ぞくせいち}を{正|ただ}しく{設定|せってい}してください。
examples.english: Please set the HTML tag attribute values correctly.

examples.japanese: このゲームではキャラクターの{属性値|ぞくせいち}によって{戦闘|せんとう}の{結果|けっか}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: In this game, the outcome of battles changes significantly depending on the character's attribute values.

notes:
A technical term composed of {属性|ぞくせい} (attribute, property) and {値|ち} (value). Used across multiple domains: in programming (HTML/CSS/XML attributes), databases (field values), and gaming (character stats like strength, agility, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {属性値|ぞくせいち}を{設定|せってい}する: to set an attribute value
- {属性値|ぞくせいち}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to get/retrieve an attribute value
- {属性値|ぞくせいち}の{一覧|いちらん}: list of attribute values
- {属性値|ぞくせいち}が{高|たか}い: high attribute value (gaming)

RELATED WORDS:
- {属性|ぞくせい}: attribute, property — the characteristic itself
- {属性名|ぞくせいめい}: attribute name — the label that identifies the attribute
- {初期値|しょきち}: initial value, default value
